name: Charter Medical LLC
old_description: We deliver scalable, single-use solutions designed for your advanced processes. Built to help you make the impossible, possible.
about:
Charter Medical LLC operates from Winston-Salem, North Carolina, where it maintains 16,000 square feet of ISO 13485-certified, FDA-registered cleanroom space. The company is part of the Solesis family of companies, alongside sister firms Polyzen, Secant Group, and SanaVita Medical, which enables integrated research and development across the life sciences portfolio.

The company designs and manufactures scalable single-use solutions for bioprocessing, therapy development, and blood management. Its product range includes bio-containers such as Freeze-Pak™ and Cell Freeze® cryogenic storage containers, fluid transfer bags and sets (Advect®, EXP-Pak™), filtration devices (AccuStrain™ 40µm and 150µm filters), and neonatal syringe sets. Charter Medical also offers custom product design, freezing studies to optimize cryogenic protocols, and manifold design for streamlined fluid management.

Charter Medical serves the cell therapy, blood transfusion, biotechnology, and pharmaceutical markets. Its solutions support clinical and commercial manufacturing workflows in bioprocessing, blood management, cell and gene therapy, cryopreservation, and filtration. Customers include biopharmaceutical innovators developing advanced therapies who require DEHP-free, closed-system processing components.

The company states its mission is to evolve single-use processing to lower costs, reduce risk, and make revolutionary therapies more accessible. It emphasizes proven customization capabilities, an innovation roadmap in design and biomaterials, and a commitment to responsiveness, collaboration, and urgency to help clients scale reliably.
